$comment: Reviewed routes from Web Awesome (--wa-*) and Shoelace (--sl-*) design tokens to Lyra document-layer tokens, read by scripts/migration-token-routes.mjs.
Only upstream token NAMES and their publicly documented values or roles were compared; no upstream source was copied.
exact: the same role, and for a metric scale the same documented value; rewritten silently and reported as a change.
approximate: the same role with a value that may differ; rewritten and reported as UPSTREAM_TOKEN_APPROXIMATE_REVIEW.
review: a known token with no Lyra equivalent; left as-is and reported as UPSTREAM_TOKEN_REVIEW with the note as the hint. reviewPatterns cover whole families the same way.
Every target must be declared by the document token layer (src/styles/tokens-root.css); scripts/migration-token-routes.test.mjs enforces it.

review.--sl-border-radius-circle: Lyra has no circle radius token; use 50%
review.--sl-border-radius-small: 0.1875rem has no Lyra radius step; the neighbours are a literal 0 and --lr-radius-xs (0.25rem)
review.--sl-border-radius-x-large: 1rem has no Lyra radius step; --lr-radius (0.5rem) is the default
review.--sl-focus-ring-offset: the Lyra focus ring offset defaults to 0px rather than 1px; use --lr-focus-ring-offset and check the gap
review.--sl-focus-ring-style: the Lyra focus ring is always solid; use --lr-focus-ring
review.--sl-font-serif: Lyra has no serif family token; declare the family yourself
review.--sl-font-size-2x-large: 2.25rem has no Lyra type step; the neighbours are --lr-font-size-3xl (2rem) and --lr-font-size-4xl (2.5rem)
review.--sl-font-size-4x-large: 4.5rem has no Lyra type step; Lyra type stops at --lr-font-size-5xl (3rem)
review.--sl-font-size-medium: Lyra has no 1rem type step; the neighbours are --lr-font-size-m (0.875rem) and --lr-font-size-lg (1.125rem)
review.--sl-font-size-x-large: 1.5rem has no Lyra type step; the neighbours are --lr-font-size-xl (1.25rem) and --lr-font-size-2xl (1.75rem)
review.--sl-font-weight-light: Lyra has no light weight token; --lr-font-weight-normal is the lightest
review.--sl-line-height-loose: 2.2 has no Lyra line-height step; --lr-line-height-loose (1.6) is the tallest
review.--sl-line-height-looser: 2.6 has no Lyra line-height step; --lr-line-height-loose (1.6) is the tallest
review.--sl-line-height-normal: 1.8 has no Lyra line-height step; --lr-line-height-loose (1.6) is the tallest
review.--sl-spacing-2x-large: 2.25rem has no Lyra spacing step; the neighbours are --lr-space-2xl (2rem) and --lr-space-3xl (3rem)
review.--sl-spacing-4x-large: 4.5rem has no Lyra spacing step; Lyra spacing stops at --lr-space-4xl (4rem)
review.--sl-spacing-large: 1.25rem has no Lyra spacing step; the neighbours are --lr-space-l (1rem) and --lr-space-xl (1.5rem)
review.--sl-spacing-x-large: 1.75rem has no Lyra spacing step; the neighbours are --lr-space-xl (1.5rem) and --lr-space-2xl (2rem)
review.--sl-transition-slow: Lyra has no 500ms interaction duration; --lr-duration-ambient (1.8s) is for ambient motion only
review.--sl-transition-x-fast: Lyra has no 50ms duration; --lr-duration-fast (120ms) is the shortest
review.--sl-transition-x-slow: Lyra has no 1000ms interaction duration; --lr-duration-ambient (1.8s) is for ambient motion only
review.--sl-z-index-dialog: Lyra stacks dialogs on --lr-layer-modal (1000), above its dropdown layer; check the relative order
review.--sl-z-index-drawer: Lyra stacks drawers on --lr-layer-modal (1000), above its dropdown layer; check the relative order
review.--wa-border-radius-circle: Lyra has no circle radius token; use 50%
review.--wa-border-radius-l: Lyra has no large radius step; use --lr-radius-container or a literal
review.--wa-border-radius-square: Lyra has no square radius token; use 0
review.--wa-border-style: Lyra has no border-style token; use solid
review.--wa-color-overlay-media: Lyra has --lr-color-overlay and --lr-color-overlay-strong; choose by contrast
review.--wa-color-surface-lowered: Lyra has no lowered surface; the surface-container steps (--lr-color-surface-container-low and siblings) are the nearest roles
review.--wa-color-text-link: Lyra has no link colour token; --lr-color-brand-fill-loud is the usual choice
review.--wa-focus-ring-style: the Lyra focus ring is always solid; use --lr-focus-ring
review.--wa-font-family-longform: Lyra has no long-form family token; use --lr-font or --lr-font-heading
review.--wa-font-size-m: Lyra has no 1rem type step; the neighbours are --lr-font-size-m (0.875rem) and --lr-font-size-lg (1.125rem)
review.--wa-font-size-scale: Lyra has no type-scale multiplier; retheme the individual --lr-theme-font-size-* inputs
review.--wa-font-weight-light: Lyra has no light weight token; --lr-font-weight-normal is the lightest
review.--wa-space-2xl: 2.5rem has no Lyra spacing step; the neighbours are --lr-space-2xl (2rem) and --lr-space-3xl (3rem)
review.--wa-space-scale: Lyra has no spacing multiplier; retheme the individual --lr-theme-space-* inputs
review.--wa-transition-slow: Lyra has no slow interaction duration; --lr-duration-ambient (1.8s) is for ambient motion only
